hero.intro: I'm Taha Toufik, a software engineer with a French master's degree in web development, and a freelance developer. You explain what you need in your own words, and I turn it into a website, an app or a tool that works. I check everything before handing it over.
hero.markets: I work with clients in France and Saudi Arabia.
hero.chat_caption: Based on a real client request

chat.text: For every order, I create the invoice, buy the shipping labels and send it all to the person who packs. It takes forever.
We can automate all of it. Your customer gets their invoice as soon as they pay, and you get a single email with the labels and the packing slip.
Will it work with the tools I already use?
Yes, I start from what you have: your website, your spreadsheets, your emails. You don't have to change a thing.

hero.whatsapp_message: Hello Taha, I'd like to talk about my project.

method.title: How I work with AI
method.intro: AI saves me a lot of time. I spend that time understanding what you need and checking the result.

steps.title: You explain what you need
steps.text: By message or on a call, in your own words. No technical specification required.

steps.title: I translate it for the AI
steps.text: I break the work into precise steps and give Claude Code all the context it needs. Communicating well with AI is what makes the result good.

steps.title: I review and test everything
steps.text: Nothing ships without being checked: the code, the mobile layout, the edge cases.

steps.title: I deliver and stay available
steps.text: You get a ready-to-use tool and clear explanations. If something needs to change, just tell me.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Live websites and apps for real clients, built with or without AI.
projects.ai_intro: With Claude Code, I go further and faster: automations that save the client hours, and complete apps.

habachiya.summary: Online store for a wholesaler of Ethiopian black seed oil. I built the site on WordPress, then used Claude Code to automate everything that happens after an order:
points: The customer receives their invoice automatically as soon as they pay.
The order is split into parcels following the client's rules (oils, honey, dates), and shipping labels are bought automatically.
The owner gets a single email per order: the labels to stick on the parcels, the packing slip and the invoice.
The order switches to “Completed” on its own once delivered, and the owner is alerted if anything goes wrong.
Customers pick their pickup point on a map at checkout.
habachiya.result: The result: after an order, all that's left is to print, stick on the labels and pack the parcel.

breakfast.summary: Click & collect app for bakeries. I took over this project and I am building it with Claude Code, for Android, iPhone and tablet:
points: Customers order and pay in the app (card, Google Pay), then pick up their order in the time slot they chose.
They see their bakery's stock for the day and follow the preparation live, with a skip-the-line QR code.
Bakers get every order as a notification and accept it in one tap, from their phone or tablet.
Sign in with Google or with a fingerprint, loyalty programme, automatic data backups.

orange.title: Orange: automated data reports
orange.summary: During my work-study at Orange, I automated the data analysis of an internal team, with no manual work at all:
points: At a set time, Cloud Scheduler triggers a serverless function (Node.js on Google Cloud).
The function collects data from several sources and formats it.
The data is stored in BigQuery, then shown as charts in Google Data Studio.
orange.result: The result: the team always has up-to-date dashboards, with nothing to prepare by hand.
